title: Plural genitive of selected longer -o/-ö words
summary: Use -iden or -itten after the final o or ö in these selected longer words: numero (“number”) → numeroiden.
targetSkills: Plural genitive of selected longer -o/-ö words
objectives: Use -iden or -itten after the final o or ö in these selected longer words: numero (“number”) → numeroiden.

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A plural genitive refers to more than one person or thing. Its ending belongs to the plural modifier, not necessarily to the thing owned. Here the task is forming the word.
Use -iden or -itten after the final o or ö in these selected longer words. The -jen alternatives shown in the examples are also standard; this is not a rule for every long word.
keyPoints: Learn the word with its stem; the last letter alone does not identify every pattern.

steps: Keep numero-: numeroiden, numeroitten and numerojen are standard alternatives.
